description: Crosshair AI tool definitions for fine-tuning. Each tool has name, description, category, status (implemented/stub), arguments schema, and return schema.

tools.name: get_project_tree
tools.description: Lists project files and directories under a given res:// root path up to a configurable depth.

tools.name: find_project_files
tools.description: Searches project paths by substring query under a root directory.

query.description: Substring to search for in file/directory names.

tools.name: read_project_file
tools.description: Reads the contents of a safe text file under res:// (project.godot, .gd, .tscn, .tres, .cfg, .gdshader, .md, .txt, .json, etc.).

tools.name: get_project_settings
tools.description: Reads key project settings such as main scene, project name, window size, and rendering method.

tools.name: get_input_actions
tools.description: Lists current input actions and their event bindings from the InputMap.

include_events.description: Whether to include the bound input events.

query.description: Optional filter substring for action names.

tools.name: get_open_scenes
tools.description: Lists currently open scene paths and unsaved scene paths in the editor.

tools.name: get_current_scene
tools.description: Returns the currently active edited scene's path, root name, root type, and child count.

tools.name: get_selected_nodes
tools.description: Returns the nodes currently selected in the editor's scene tree.

tools.name: get_scene_tree
tools.description: Returns a serialized tree of nodes in a scene, optionally including specific properties.

include_properties.description: Property names to include per node (e.g. ['script','position']).

tools.name: get_node_details
tools.description: Returns detailed information about a specific node in a scene, including type, properties, and children.

node_path.description: Node path relative to scene root.

tools.name: get_node_api
tools.description: Returns available methods, signals, and properties for a specific node in a scene.

tools.name: batch_tool_calls
tools.description: Executes multiple tool calls in a single batch. Supports shared_arguments that apply to all calls. GDScript tools (create_gdscript_file, update_gdscript_file) MUST NOT be mixed with other tools in the same batch.

dry_run.description: If true, list resolved calls without executing.

shared_arguments.description: Arguments merged into every call (e.g. scene_path).

calls.description: List of tool calls to execute.

tools.name: open_scene
tools.description: Opens a scene in the editor by its resource path.

scene_path.description: Scene resource path starting with res://.

tools.name: save_current_scene
tools.description: Saves the currently edited scene to disk.

tools.name: save_all_scenes
tools.description: Saves all currently open scenes with unsaved changes.

tools.name: reload_scene
tools.description: Reloads a scene from disk, discarding unsaved changes.

tools.name: create_scene_file
tools.description: Creates a new .tscn scene file with a specified root node type and name. Optionally opens it.

root_type.description: Instantiable Node class for the root.

root_name.description: Name for the root node. Defaults to filename base.

open.description: Whether to open the scene after creation.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing scene.

tools.name: create_gdscript_file
tools.description: Creates a new GDScript file with the given contents. MUST be in its own batch_tool_calls (cannot mix with non-GDScript tools).

tools.name: update_gdscript_file
tools.description: Updates an existing GDScript file by replacing, appending, or prepending content. MUST be in its own batch_tool_calls (cannot mix with non-GDScript tools).

tools.name: attach_script
tools.description: Attaches a GDScript file to a node in a scene (sets the 'script' property).

node_path.description: Node path relative to scene root.

script_path.description: GDScript resource path starting with res://.

tools.name: add_node
tools.description: Adds a new node of the given type as a child of the specified parent in a scene.

node_type.description: Instantiable Godot class name (e.g. Node3D, CharacterBody3D).

tools.name: instantiate_scene
tools.description: Instantiates a PackedScene as a child node in the current scene.

node_name.description: Optional custom name for the instance.

tools.name: add_primitive_mesh
tools.description: Adds a MeshInstance3D with a primitive mesh (box, sphere, capsule, cylinder, plane) as a child node.

parameters.description: Mesh-specific parameters: box→{size:{x,y,z}}, sphere→{radius,height}, capsule→{radius,height}, cylinder→{top_radius,bottom_radius,height}, plane→{size:{x,z}}.

tools.name: add_collision_shape
tools.description: Adds a CollisionShape3D child to a 3D physics body with a specified shape type.

parameters.description: Shape parameters: box→{size:{x,y,z}}, sphere→{radius}, capsule→{radius,height}, cylinder→{radius,height}.

tools.name: add_2d_collision_shape
tools.description: Adds a CollisionShape2D child to a 2D physics body with a specified shape type.

tools.name: create_standard_material
tools.description: Creates a StandardMaterial3D resource and optionally assigns it to a node's material property.

node_path.description: Optional: node to assign material to.

property.description: Property name on the target node.

tools.name: assign_resource_to_property
tools.description: Assigns a resource (by path) to a property on a scene node.

tools.name: connect_signal
tools.description: Connects a signal from a source node to a method on a target node in a scene.

tools.name: create_input_action
tools.description: Creates a new input action with the specified events and deadzone.

tools.name: set_main_scene
tools.description: Sets the project's main scene in project.godot.

scene_path.description: Scene path to set as main.

tools.name: play_current_scene
tools.description: Starts playing the currently edited scene in the editor.

tools.name: play_main_scene
tools.description: Starts playing the project's main scene.

tools.name: stop_playing_scene
tools.description: Stops the currently running game in the editor.

tools.name: remove_node
tools.description: Removes a node from the current scene. Cannot remove the scene root.

tools.name: set_node_property
tools.description: Sets a property value on a scene node. For Vector3 position use {"property":"position","value":{"x":0,"y":1,"z":0}}.

value.description: Value to set (type depends on property).

tools.name: write_project_file
tools.description: Writes content to a safe text file under res://.

path.description: Target file path starting with res://.

tools.name: create_project_folder
tools.description: Creates a directory under res:// (including intermediate directories).

tools.name: delete_project_file
tools.description: Deletes a file under res://. Requires confirm:true for safety.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deletion.

tools.name: move_project_file
tools.description: Moves or renames a file under res://. Destination must not exist.

tools.name: file_exists
tools.description: Checks whether a res:// path exists as a file or directory. Returns size and type for files.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Lists one directory level under a res:// path.

tools.name: grep_project_files
tools.description: Searches file contents under res:// by substring. Defaults to .gd, .tscn, .godot, .tres, .cfg, .gdshader, .md, .txt, .json.

tools.name: get_unsaved_scenes
tools.description: Lists scenes with unsaved edits.

tools.name: reparent_node
tools.description: Moves a node to a new parent in the same scene.

tools.name: rename_node
tools.description: Renames a node in the scene tree.

tools.name: duplicate_node
tools.description: Duplicates a node and adds it under a specified parent.

tools.name: move_child
tools.description: Changes the order of a node among its siblings.

tools.name: edit_script
tools.description: Opens a script in the script editor at an optional line and column.

tools.name: select_file
tools.description: Focuses a file in the FileSystem dock.

tools.name: set_editor_main_screen
tools.description: Switches the main editor tab (2D, 3D, Script, Game, AssetLib).

tools.name: get_editor_log
tools.description: Returns recent editor Output/error/warning lines (newest first).

tools.name: capture_editor_viewport
tools.description: Captures the 2D or 3D editor viewport as PNG (base64).

tools.name: capture_game_viewport
tools.description: Captures the running game viewport as PNG (base64). Only works when a scene is playing.

tools.name: get_debug_snapshot
tools.description: Bundles log tail, current scene, selection, unsaved scenes, and play state for quick diagnosis.

tools.name: get_autoloads
tools.description: Lists project autoload singletons and their script paths.

tools.name: get_node_groups
tools.description: Lists the groups a node belongs to.

tools.name: get_node_collision_layers
tools.description: Reads collision_layer and collision_mask for a CollisionObject2D/3D.

tools.name: get_animation_player_state
tools.description: Summarizes an AnimationPlayer node: animations list, current animation, position, length, active state.

tools.name: get_tilemap_info
tools.description: Summarizes a TileMap node: layers, tileset, used rect.

tools.name: get_navigation_region_info
tools.description: Summarizes a NavigationRegion2D/3D node: enabled, layers, bounds, baking state.

tools.name: editor_undo
tools.description: Runs the editor undo stack (default 1 step, max 50).

tools.name: get_runtime_debugger_state
tools.description: Reads the script debugger state (errors, warnings, stack file/line when broken).

tools.name: create_light
tools.description: Creates a 3D light node (directional, omni, or spot) and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_camera_3d
tools.description: Creates a Camera3D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_rigid_body_3d
tools.description: Creates a RigidBody3D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_static_body_3d
tools.description: Creates a StaticBody3D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_character_body_3d
tools.description: Creates a CharacterBody3D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_area_3d
tools.description: Creates an Area3D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_ray_cast_3d
tools.description: Creates a RayCast3D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: add_csg_primitive
tools.description: Creates a CSG primitive (box, cylinder, sphere, torus) and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_path_3d
tools.description: Creates a Path3D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_vehicle_body_3d
tools.description: Creates a VehicleBody3D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_sprite_2d
tools.description: Creates a Sprite2D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_animated_sprite_2d
tools.description: Creates an AnimatedSprite2D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_rigid_body_2d
tools.description: Creates a RigidBody2D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_character_body_2d
tools.description: Creates a CharacterBody2D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_area_2d
tools.description: Creates an Area2D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_ray_cast_2d
tools.description: Creates a RayCast2D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_line_2d
tools.description: Creates a Line2D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_path_2d
tools.description: Creates a Path2D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_polygon_2d
tools.description: Creates a Polygon2D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_light_2d
tools.description: Creates a Light2D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: create_shape_cast_3d
tools.description: Creates a ShapeCast3D node and adds it to the scene.

tools.name: get_global_classes
tools.description: Lists instantiable Godot classes with their parent class. Optionally filter by query.

tools.name: search_project_settings_keys
tools.description: Searches project setting keys by pattern substring.

tools.name: get_editor_settings
tools.description: Reads editor settings, optionally filtered by prefix.

tools.name: get_binary_file_metadata
tools.description: Returns metadata (size, modified time) for a binary file under res://.

tools.name: get_editor_version
tools.description: Returns the current editor version string.
